prompt_text: what is the actual IMDB and rotten tomatoes rating of Interstellar
response_text:
**Interstellar (2014)**  

| Source | Rating | Notes | Date of reference |
|--------|--------|-------|-------------------|
| **IMDb** | **8.6 / 10** | Based on ~ 1.2 million user votes. | 2026‑09‑13 |
| **Rotten Tomatoes** | **72 % (Tomatometer)** | 72 % of professional critics gave it a positive review. | 2026‑09‑13 |
| | **94 % (Audience Score)** | 94 % of audience members rated it 3 / 5 stars or higher. | 2026‑09‑13 |

> **Quick recap**  
> - **IMDb**: 8.6/10 (user‑rated)  
> - **Rotten Tomatoes**: 72% critic approval (Tomatometer) and 94% audience approval (Audience Score)

> **Why the numbers matter**  
> - **IMDb** reflects the aggregate opinion of millions of viewers worldwide.  
> - **Rotten Tomatoes** splits into a critic score (Tomatometer) and an audience score, giving a fuller picture of how the film was received by both professionals and general movie‑goers.

> **Keep in mind**  
> Ratings can shift slightly as new votes or reviews come in. If you need the most up‑to‑date numbers, check the official IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes pages directly.
